Container.Name: ReelVault
Container.Overview: Plex-style video player for one job: browse your library, play anything, grab full-quality screenshots and export trimmed clips. Point it at a read-only media share (Plex or TRaSH folder layout): it scans movies and shows, plays any file in the browser through an on-the-fly H.264 preview, and captures screenshots (PNG at source resolution, HDR tone-mapped) and clips (MP4) from the ORIGINAL files into an output share, one folder per title. No GPU, no database, and it never writes to your library. TZ is taken from Unraid automatically.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Reel Vault web interface. The container always listens on 7727; change only the host side.

Config.Name: Media Library (read-only)
Config.Description: Root of your video library in Plex or TRaSH layout (movies, tv, anime...). Mounted read-only: Reel Vault never writes here. Folders are scanned recursively for .mkv .mp4 .m4v .avi .ts .mov .webm .mpg .wmv files.

Config.Name: Captures Output
Config.Description: Where screenshots (PNG) and clips (MP4) are written, one sub-folder per movie or show. Must be writable by PUID:PGID.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Library index, probe and waveform caches, and the temporary transcode segments for playback. Safe to delete; it is rebuilt on the next scan. Keep it on your cache pool.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid default 99 = nobody). Captures are owned by this user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid default 100 = users).

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity: trace, debug, info, warn or error. debug also logs every ffmpeg command line.

Config.Name: Library Scan Interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often the library is rescanned for new files. 0 disables periodic scans (the refresh button in the app still works).
